test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
A statement is given followed by two arguments I and II. Read the statement and the arguments carefully and select the appropriate answer from the given options.

Statement:

Students have complained that questions outside the prescribed syllabus were asked in the X standard board exams this year.

Arguments:

I. The pass percentage in the X standard board exams has declined by 8 percent this year.

II. This number of students scoring over 60 percent in the X standard board exams has shown an increase of 15 percent this year.

options.text: Both arguments I and II weaken the statement
Argument II weakens, while argument I strengthens the statement
Both arguments I and II strenthen the statement
Argument I weakens, while argument II strengthens the statement

solution:
**Given:**

Statement:

Students have complained that questions outside the prescribed syllabus were asked in the X standard board exams this year.

**Conclusion:**

Arguments:

I. The pass percentage in the X standard board exams has declined by 8 percent this year. **True : **As the question were outside the prescribed syllabus , so there is possibility that students will score less marks and pass percentage will decrease , Hence this argument strengthens the statemen. 

II. This number of students scoring over 60 percent in the X standard board exams has shown an increase of 15 percent this year. **False: ** As the question were outside the prescribed syllabus , so there is possibility that students will score less marks but here the pass percentage is increasing so this case weakens the statement.

**Thus the correct answer is '****Argument II weakens, while argument I strengthens the statement ' .**
